summary: Ansible 9 deprecations: the community.azure, hpe.nimble, netapp.azure, netapp.elementsw and netapp.um_info collections are unmaintained and will be removed from Ansible 10 unless someone maintains them, and community.sap was renamed to community.sap_libs.
questions: Is community.azure being removed from Ansible?
Which collections were removed in Ansible 10 for being unmaintained?
